item.text: I’ll inspect the existing issue service, event handling, and notification flow, then implement the hierarchy rules within those patterns.

The existing notification fan-out already handles preferences and suppresses self-notifications. I’m using that path for completion notices and keeping hierarchy traversal unpaginated so roll-ups and cascades include every descendant.
